question: Could you tell us your favorite food, or something you often eat or drink while taking a break from writing?
answer:
There was an almond snack at the recording studio that was incredibly delicious (laughs).

It was ridiculously tasty, but when I looked at the bag, I was shocked by how many calories it had!

The bag was about the size of a bag of Kakinotane, but it contained around 150 kcal.

I realized I had been eating a ridiculous amount of calories and immediately regretted it, but it was the most delicious thing I've eaten recently.

I also often drink vegetable juice.

I think I've even been nicknamed “Vegetable Juice” at the family restaurant I often go to.
